title: Field Notes
summary: Turn scattered reading into a connected trail of ideas.

cover.alt: Illustrative Field Notes interface for this fictional project

screenshots.alt: Detail of the fictional Field Notes workspace, labeled as a design preview

story.problem: Research notes accumulate faster than we can reconnect them to their original sources.
story.built: A local notebook that groups related passages and keeps citations attached to every summary.
story.aiUse: A small model suggests themes from a selected collection. The source passage stays one click away.
story.humanDecisions: I chose a local storage model, made provenance visible, and tested whether suggestions remain tied to the supplied text.
story.limitations: This example uses a small curated collection. Suggested connections may still need correction.
